names: سديه دوف (שדה דב)؛ «حي سديه دوف» (اسم الموقع: حي سديه دوف). مطار دوف هوز. المجمعات: أشكول (منطقة أشكول، كما في خريطة الموقع)، مركز الحي، شمال الحي. المشاريع بأسمائها اللاتينية كما يكتبها المطوّرون: Rainbow Tel Aviv (Israel Canada)، FIRST (Hagag Group)، ASHIRA (Avisror Moshe & Sons)، DIMRI YAMA (Y.H. Dimri؛ المهندس رني زيس، التصميم الداخلي Kelly Hoppen)، ZOHI، GINDI VOGUE (Gindi Holdings)، UTOPIA (Nahmias Group)، Mediterranean Towers (מגדלי הים התיכון، سكن محمي لكبار السن). المقاول الرئيسي Ashtrom. الأماكن: تسوكي أفيف، شارع بروبس، نافيه يام، تخنيت لامد (תכנית ל׳)، شارع ليفي أشكول، كوخاف هتسافون، مجمع ريدينغ، شارع شاي عجنون، حديقة اليركون، ابن جبيرول، رمات أفيف (هكذا يُبحث عنها)، بارك تسامرت، الخط الأخضر للقطار الخفيف. الجهات: سلطة أراضي إسرائيل، اللجنة اللوائية في تل أبيب، اللجنة المحلية في تل أبيب يافا، بلدية تل أبيب يافا. القوانين: قانون البيع (شقق) وكفالة قانون البيع. مصطلحات: ضريبة الشراء، ضريبة التحسين (هيتل هشبحاه)، رسوم الإدارة، البيع على الخارطة (ما قبل البيع)، حساب المرافقة البنكية. الأماكن التي لا اسم عربياً لها في مصدرها تبقى بالإنجليزية: لا اسم مخترَع.

culture: عربية فصحى معاصرة واضحة، قريبة من لغة الصحافة الاقتصادية. شرح عدد الغرف الإسرائيلي مرة واحدة («4 غرف: صالون وثلاث غرف نوم»). كفالة قانون البيع تُشرح مرة واحدة. نبرة دافئة وواثقة.
typography: أرقام غربية كما تكتبها الصحافة العربية في إسرائيل (83,000 ₪؛ 9.45 مليون ₪)؛ تواريخ 12.3.2020؛ أسماء الأشهر الشامية (آذار، نيسان...) عند ذكر الشهر بالكلمة؛ بلا شرطة طويلة (—) وبلا شرطة متوسطة (–).
units: م² و₪ فقط. يمكن شرح الدونم مرة واحدة (1 دونم = 1,000 م²).

claims.claim: The Israeli room count includes the living room: '4 rooms' = a living room and 3 bedrooms; a '1-room' unit is a studio.
claims.write_as: Explain once for a foreign reader; never convert to bedrooms in a table.

claims.claim: A dunam (the Israeli land unit) is 1,000 m2.
claims.write_as: Allowed once, to explain the unit. No other conversions (no sq ft, no acres, no hectares, no dollars or euros).

claims.claim: Quarters: 'the first quarter of 2026' = January to March 2026 (Q1, 1-3.2026).
claims.write_as: 'Q1 2026' or 'the first quarter of 2026'. Keep the year.

claims.claim: The Sde Dov quarter (rova), on the site of the former airfield in north-west Tel Aviv-Yafo, is planned for about 16,000 apartments ('16 thousand') in three compounds: Eshkol (south-east), the Centre and the North.
claims.conflict: '15,000-20,000 units' (an English guide) is not the plan: never use it.
claims.write_as: 'about 16,000 apartments planned'. Never a delivery date for the whole quarter.

claims.claim: A survey of the developers' annual reports published in April 2026: about 1,280 apartments sold in the quarter so far; their average price about ₪83,000 per m2; a 4-room apartment sold for about ₪9.45 million on average.
claims.conflict: An older page figure 'about 81,000' and an average 'about 7 million per deal' have no source: never use them.
claims.write_as: 'about ₪83,000 per m2' (an average of sold units, not an asking price).

claims.claim: In 2026 most projects in the quarter sell at about ₪70,000 per m2.
Per the developers' 2025 reports, the sales averages of the projects in the Eshkol compound ranged from about ₪63,400 to about ₪82,600 per m2, VAT included.
The largest deal published in the quarter: an apartment of about 390 m2 with a balcony of about 200 m2 on floor 38 of a tower in the Central compound, sold in December 2025 for more than ₪42 million.
claims.conflict: '43.75 million for 508 m2' had no source: never use it.

claims.claim: Sde Dov (Dov Hoz airport) was inaugurated on 23 September 1938, with the Tel Aviv - Haifa - Beirut air line; it closed on 1 July 2019 and its evacuation was completed early in 2020.
claims.conflict: Some English sources say 30 June 2019 (the last day of flights): write 1 July 2019, as the Hebrew does.
claims.write_as: The city is Tel Aviv; the line name keeps the three cities.

claims.claim: The quarter covers about 1,300 dunam along the sea in north Tel Aviv; its coastal front (the coastal park) is about 2 km long.
claims.conflict: '1,500 dunam' (also 1,490 / 1,600 in some press and marketing) has no official basis: never use it.
claims.write_as: 'about 1,300 dunam'. 'about 1.3 km2' is NOT allowed (a new number).

claims.claim: Boundaries: the Tzukei Aviv neighbourhood and Propes Street (north); Neve Yam, Plan L (Tochnit Lamed) and Levi Eshkol Street (east); Kochav HaTzafon, the Reading compound and Shai Agnon Street (south); the beach and the promenade (west).
claims.write_as: No distances. The port of Tel Aviv is NOT a boundary.

claims.claim: The master plan describes a mixed-use quarter of about 16,000 apartments for about 40,000 residents; it came into force in August 2020.
claims.write_as: 'about 40,000 residents' (41,000 appears in some press: never use it).

claims.claim: Per the plan approved in 2020: about 500,000 m2 of public buildings, about 125,000 m2 of hotels and about 365 dunam of parks and public gardens; of the 16,000 apartments about 2,400 are for affordable housing at a reduced price and about 4,500 for special housing (student dormitories, assisted living, rental housing).
claims.conflict: '4,500 to 6,900 special-housing units' misreads the source (6,900 = 2,400 + 4,500): never write 6,900.

claims.claim: The three compounds: Eshkol (TAMAL/3001) about 4,800 apartments, about 45,000 m2 of commerce, about 145,000 m2 of employment; the Centre about 7,100 apartments (7,128 in the approved plan), about 60,000 m2 of commerce, about 155,000 m2 of employment and about 800 hotel rooms; the North about 4,000 apartments, about 20,000 m2 of commerce, about 30,000 m2 of employment and about 1,150 hotel rooms. No separate hotel figure for Eshkol.
claims.write_as: The Eshkol hotel cell stays without a number.

claims.claim: Dates in force: the master plan August 2020; the Eshkol detailed plan May 2021; the Centre and North detailed plans 2025.
claims.conflict: 'Eshkol preceded the master plan' is wrong: never write it.

claims.claim: In February and March 2025, eight land tenders closed for 6,666 apartments, more than 40% of the apartments planned in the quarter.
claims.write_as: 'eight tenders' in words or 8; never 41.7% (not in the Hebrew).

claims.claim: Rainbow Tel Aviv (Israel Canada, Eshkol compound): a tower of 39 to 40 floors and boutique buildings; 459 apartments per the developer (the land tender spoke of 480); the main contractor Ashtrom was chosen in January 2026; delivery in stages, the last stage expected in 2030.
claims.conflict: '480 per marketing / 459 per permit' were wrong attributions: never use them.
claims.write_as: 2030 is the expected last stage, not a contractual date.

claims.claim: Project facts (as the area map cards): FIRST, a 45-floor tower and three boutique buildings of 9 floors, 350 apartments; ASHIRA, 406 apartments in four buildings including a 35-floor tower; DIMRI YAMA, 458 apartments in a 40-floor tower, a 16-floor mid-rise (towerlet) and two 9-floor buildings; ZOHI, about 230 apartments; GINDI VOGUE, 708 apartments on two lots in the Centre, including a 45-floor tower and three 20-floor towers; UTOPIA, 337 apartments in four buildings around a shared courtyard in Eshkol.
claims.write_as: Only if the Hebrew row carries it (the six table cells are optional edits).

claims.claim: Rainbow Tel Aviv: the average of all apartments sold up to March 2026 was about ₪81,800 per m2.
claims.conflict: 'about 82,000' was the rounded, undated form: use 81,800 with its date.

claims.claim: At these prices (about ₪70,000 to ₪83,000 per m2) a 100 m2 apartment costs about ₪7 to ₪8.3 million (a calculation, as the price calculator on the prices page).
claims.conflict: 'a 100 m2 apartment about 8 million' was 100 x an unsourced 80,000: never use it.

claims.claim: Land prices in the tenders: about ₪3.3 million per apartment on average in the 2022 tenders (development costs included); about ₪1.7 to ₪2.2 million per apartment in the February 2025 tender for regular (for-sale) apartment buildings (the rental tenders of that month were far lower).
claims.conflict: 'over 3 million per unit' without a year: never use it.

claims.claim: Luxury deals of ₪14 million and more have been published in the quarter (since 10.2024).
Public participation: five meetings during the master plan; four topic meetings for the detailed plans (traffic and transport; building and urban design; building and programme; housing).
'In a new neighbourhood you buy the apartment and also the first ten years of the neighbourhood being built around it' (the page's own line).
The page was checked and updated in October 2026 (7.10.2026).
claims.write_as: Only in the Hebrew page; the translations carry no date line.
